node.title: Re: links from perldoc to rt.perl.org bug reports seem to be broken
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: The link appears to be correct in [https://perl5.git.perl.org/perl.git/blob/v5.26.0:/pod/perldelta.pod#l436|the source], so I suspect it's a formatting issue on the site. I believe the correct place to report issues for that is [https://github.com/jonallen/perldoc.perl.org/issues].
